New section to explain how non-crypto fiat buyers collect commissions and prizes. This is key for normies — they get a non-custodial wallet spun up behind the scenes (no seed phrase), but might not know how to access rewards.
something like this,

"How Does a Non-Crypto Fiat Buyer Collect Commissions and Prizes?":

If you're buying with fiat (credit card, Apple Pay, etc.) and new to crypto, don't worry — the process is designed to be simple. When you mint the book for $15 via Transak, a non-custodial wallet is automatically created for you behind the scenes (no seed phrase needed). This wallet holds your NFT and receives any commissions or prizes.

Here's how it works step by step:
During the Purchase:
Transak handles the fiat-to-crypto conversion and mints the NFT directly to a new wallet address for you.
You don't need to set up anything manually — it's seamless and non-custodial (you own the keys, but no complicated seed phrase to manage right away).
You'll get an email confirmation with your mint number (your referral code), NFT details, and a link to your dashboard on <http://projectrebuild.xyz|projectrebuild.xyz>.

Earning Commissions ($5 per Referral):
Share your referral code (e.g., "use 8421"). When someone mints with it, $5 is automatically sent to your wallet address.
To collect: Log into your dashboard on <http://projectrebuild.xyz|projectrebuild.xyz> (using the email link or SIWE with the wallet Transak created). Your commissions appear there instantly — no action needed. If needed, we'll guide you on exporting to a bank account or exchange (e.g., via Coinbase).

Earning and Winning Prizes (Tickets for $500/$10,000 Draws):
Each referral gives you tickets for the current prize draws. These are tied to your NFT/wallet automatically.
Draws happen on-chain (every ~100 sales for $500, ~10,000 for $10,000) via fair randomness.
Winners are announced on the Winners page and emailed to you.

To collect a prize: If you win, the amount ($500 or $10,000) is sent straight to your wallet.
Check your dashboard/email for notifications

how_it_works_copy.mint: Purchase the ebook NFT for $15 USD; the mint number is the referral code.
how_it_works_copy.referrals: Sharing the mint number or link earns an instant $5 USD for each referred mint, with no limit or expiration; when no code is used, the commission and tickets go to a random existing ticket holder.
how_it_works_copy.tickets: Each referral gives Small and Big Block prize tickets for the current blocks, and more referrals provide more chances to win.
how_it_works_copy.prizes: Small Block awards 1 × $500 every 100 sales and Big Block awards 1 × $10,000 every 10,000 sales, counting mint and secondary sales, with winners selected through Chainlink VRF.
how_it_works_copy.reward_collection: Commissions and prize winnings are sent automatically to the recipient's wallet, with prize winners announced on the Winners page and notified by email.

decisions.reason: Automatic transfer of a winning prize does not change ticket issuance, counters, eligibility windows, transfer behavior, or post-draw reset rules.
The source restates the existing Big Block amount and interval but changes only how winners receive payouts, not the Big Block prize mechanism.
The source restates the existing Small Block amount and interval but changes only how winners receive payouts, not the Small Block prize mechanism.
Automatic winner payout does not determine whether prize-pool funds use Aave, so the existing lifecycle ambiguity remains unresolved.

The source changes collection of prizes after winning and does not alter allocation of commissions or tickets when a mint has no referral code.
Prize payout destination and collection interaction do not change secondary-sale royalty amount, enforcement, founder share, pool destinations, or ticket-generation behavior.
The Mission page already describes automatic payouts and contains no manual-claim statement that must be removed.
